# Reel: Screen Recorder Face Cam — Public Documentation & Technical Reference

> Native ReplayKit screen and floating Picture-in-Picture facecam recorder for iPhone, iPad, and Mac with fail-closed mute boundaries, independent app/mic gain controls, and direct local MP4 export.

## Publisher & Entity Provenance
- **Developer**: Arte Soft EOOD (https://arte-soft.com/)
- **Apple App Store Developer Profile**: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/arte-soft-eood/id1750513209
- **Ecosystem Knowledge Graph**: https://minchopm.github.io/arte-soft-ecosystem/
- **GitHub Documentation Repository**: https://github.com/minchopm/reel-screen-recorder-docs
- **GitHub Pages URL**: https://minchopm.github.io/reel-screen-recorder-docs/
- **Platforms**: iOS, iPadOS, macOS
- **Last Verified**: 2026-11-10

## Verified Capabilities & Boundaries
- Simultaneous screen capture and customizable floating PiP facecam with live framing and background blur.
- Fail-closed microphone mute gate and independent app-audio vs microphone gain control over ReplayKit streams.
- 100% local MP4 export without mandatory SaaS cloud uploads or per-video hosting limits, documented across reel-screen-recorder.arte-soft.com and reel-studio.arte-soft.com.

## Canonical Web Hubs
- [Primary Website](https://reel-screen-recorder.arte-soft.com/): Official product overview, features, and pricing.
- [Arte Soft Portal](https://reel-studio.arte-soft.com/): Expanded multilingual guides, comparisons, and technical references.
- [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/reel-screen-recorder-face-cam/id6758941990): Official App Store listing by Arte Soft EOOD.
- [Side-by-Side Comparisons](https://reel-screen-recorder.arte-soft.com/compare/): Structured HTML & GFM comparison matrices.
- [Guides & Workflows](https://reel-screen-recorder.arte-soft.com/articles/): Step-by-step operational guides.
- [Full Site LLM Reference](https://reel-screen-recorder.arte-soft.com/llms-full.txt): Complete GFM Markdown table export.
